PLAN "12-Week Bone-Loading Hybrid for Perimenopause Client"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "bone density maintenance and strength gain with cooling protocols"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Bone-loading compounds + cooling":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5 minutes
          lower_back_stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper emphasis with emphasis on form and tempo":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
          shoulder_prehab 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_opening 5 minutes
          arm_crosses 2 minutes
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Lower focus + cooling protocol":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
          hip_openers 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 2 minutes
          quad_stretch 3 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 65m "Progression + cooldown protocol":
        warmup:
          cycling 6 minutes
          scapular_retraction 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          back_squat 4x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          breath_control_cooldown 6 minutes
          mobility_flow 5 minutes
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Push-pull density with tempo control":
        warmup:
          rower 5 minutes
          band_external_rotation 4 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          overhead_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 4 minutes
          neck_relax 2 minutes
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Friday training 65m "Lower density with extra cooling":
        warmup:
          walk 5 minutes
          leg_m swings 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          sumo_deadlift 3x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          leg_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          lying_leg_raise 3 minutes
          hip_flexor_stretch 3 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 70m "Advanced loading with controlled environment":
        warmup:
          cycling 6 minutes
          scapular_retraction 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x4 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          deadlift 3x5 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          bench_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
        cooldown:
          cool_breathing 6 minutes
          full_bodyMobility 5 minutes
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Pull emphasis + tempo work":
        warmup:
          row 5 minutes
          banded_rows 4 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          overhead_press 3x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_opener 4 minutes
          gentle stretching 5 minutes
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Friday training 70m "Lower compound cycle + cooling":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 4 minutes
          hip_openers 4 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          back_squat 4x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          Romanian_deadlift 3x6 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 3 minutes
          quad_stretch 3 minutes

SYNTAX RULES:
- Rep ranges use two dots: 3x8..12
- Sets always come first: 4x6
- RPE goes after sets/reps: rpe 7
- Rest in seconds: rest 120 seconds
